summary: Verified the iteration_4 decline-bug fix and the two new service categories (ride_share + towing) end-to-end. Backend: 95/95 pytest pass (89 prior regression + 6 new in test_lumo_categories.py). Decline guard now correctly returns 403 with body containing 'not awaiting approval' when status != pending_approval; non-owner decline returns 403; missing booking returns 404; first decline of pending_approval returns 200 {declined:true}. ride_share and towing jobs POST 200 with category_group='physical_delivery' and appear in /api/jobs feed (incl. category_group_filter=physical_delivery). Frontend: /customer Post-a-job dropdown shows 'Ride / Rideshare' (idx 3) and 'Towing / Roadside' (idx 4) immediately after 'Moving' (idx 2). Selecting Towing renders service-details with ALL 7 expected detail-* fields and 10 subcategories; selecting Ride renders ALL 6 expected detail-* fields and 6 subcategories. detail-scheduled_for correctly renders as <input type='datetime-local'> for both urgency=scheduled (tow) and timing=scheduled (ride). No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: decline_rental_booking (server.py:1574) now mirrors approve_rental_booking's status guard with a 403 + descriptive message ('Booking is not awaiting approval (status: ...)'). Fix is correct and asymmetric-state risk noted in iteration_4 is resolved.

ALL_CATEGORIES order in server.py:57-65 and frontend api.js are aligned — both place ride_share and towing right after 'moving' in the delivery/transport block, matching the dropdown ordering requirement.

ServiceDetailsForm.jsx already supports textarea + datetime-local field types (lines 57-79). The schema-driven render correctly hides scheduled_for until the parent timing/urgency field is set to 'scheduled' via fieldVisible's showIf check.

Minor: scheduled_for in the towing/ride schemas does not declare a showIf clause — it is always rendered when subcategory is set, not gated on urgency/timing. In practice fieldVisible returns true by default, so the field is visible even when urgency=now. Not a blocker (label says 'If scheduled, when?') but could be tightened with showIf:{urgency:'scheduled'} or showIf:{timing:'scheduled'} for cleaner UX. Test still passed because the field exists post-select.
server.py is now ~3413 lines — keep the split-to-routers note from iteration_4.
